research_questions.question: What minimal fail-closed lineage rule should the v2.3 bus enforce so active_parent_state_git_identity proves both Git-object existence and an allowed immediate prior-state transition, including explicit protocol/plan migration cases?
research_questions.why_it_matters: Current frozen validation proves syntax and cross-file equality but not existence or semantic validity of the referenced parent state.
research_questions.closure_criterion: A frozen verifier rejects a nonexistent 40-hex parent, resolves the actual parent object, validates the parent state's required identity fields, and checks an explicit transition relation for same-version and version-migration cases.
preferred_source_families: software supply-chain provenance and attestation standards

adversarial_probe.name: PARENT_GIT_OBJECT_EXISTENCE_GAP
adversarial_probe.attack: Substitute a nonexistent but schema-valid 40-hex parent identity consistently across current state, control, and assignment. The frozen schemas allow the value and the frozen validator has no Git-object resolution or prior-state content check.
adversarial_probe.discriminator: The all-zero 40-hex object identifier returned GitHub 404, while all three schemas accept the same lexical form.
adversarial_probe.bounded_conclusion: The frozen CI validator cannot by itself certify parent-state object existence. The actual CAL-004 parent resolves, so this is a validator-completeness defect rather than evidence of current cohort corruption.

cost_ledger.notes: One narrow replay-safe lineage falsifier plus mandatory frozen-control/auth checks; zero fresh, protected, benchmark, or deep-research consumption.
